answer: To secure autonomous agent sortition, we implement recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments coupled with a staking collateral mechanism at each transaction jetty. This construction forces adversaries to commit substantial capital subject to slashing penalties, establishing a robust Nash equilibrium of negative expected attack utility. Rather than relying on a centralized relic of trust, our zero-knowledge verifiable delay primitive enforces sequential computation, diffusing identity-cloning vectors across the peer-to-peer zephyr.
